ZY Sweets For Your Sweetie Fundraiser

Buy some Sweets for your Sweetie from Zeta Upsilon Feb 9-12, from 5-8 pm in the Maytag Atrium for only $3! You can choose between chocolate candies, fruit-flavored candies, or a mix to show how well you know your Sweetie!

Aluminum Can Drive for Lake View Camp!!

Calling all pop, Bublr, Monster, V8 lovers.. WE WANT YOUR ALUMINUM CANS! During the month of February we will be collecting aluminum cans & taking them to the Redemption Center to collect $$ for Lake View Camp. All proceeds will go toward sponsoring kids to attend a life changing week of summer camp! Find boxes located in Vermeer, Weller, Lower Chapel, Central Hall, & Maytag. Lasts through 2/25.

We will meet at 7 pm on Monday, February 23rd, in Weller 201. If you have any questions, please email andersonr3@central.edu

A leprechaun has swiped your gold—do you have what it takes to get it back? Gather a team of up to four for a high-stakes, 30-minute race against the clock. Solve riddles, crack codes, and outwit the luck of the Irish! 

Date: Sunday, March 1 

Time: 7:00 PM – 9:00 PM (Arrive 10 minutes early) 

Location: BMW Rooms 

The fastest team wins a grand prize and campus-wide bragging rights. Spots are limited—sign up now! (must use central email in order to sign up)

The Calm: worship, message, community, & sometimes snacks :)

Feeling overwhelmed? Discouraged? Anxious for the start of the week?! Then start your week off right by joining us for Sunday night worship at THE CALM, 8:30 pm in the Upper Chapel! We will be diving in to the book of John. Enjoy worship, a message, & community. All are welcome. We would love to see you!

CAPIC is hosting Late Night Central at Fred’s on Friday, February 20th, from 8:00–9:30 PM! Join us for free boba and a chance to win one of three Walmart gift cards. Bring your friends and come hang out for a fun night on campus.

Free Home-Cooked Lent Breakfast!

Join us every Wednesday morning from 7-7:45 am in the Lower Chapel starting 2/25 until 4/1 for some good home-cooked breakfast. Breakfast is provided by a local church, along with a devo, & wonderful community to start your Wednesday right!

Professional Networking Event

Meet with a professional or professor in your possible career interest area over dinner. Hear about their journey and current life with opportunities to ask questions. Currently, we have professionals comingfrom the following areas: business management (owning their own business), entrepreneurship, nursing, law enforcement, sports marketing, human resources, etc. 
This will take place in the side rooms in Central Market beginning at 6:00 pm on Tues., Feb. 24. 

Please sign up with your name & possible profession in the SSS Office or email: diehlm@central.edu

HLC Visit Coming

Central College will host a team from the Higher Learning Commission (HLC) for a scheduled accreditation visit the week of Feb. 22–25. HLC is a national accrediting body that evaluates colleges and universities to confirm they meet established standards for educational quality, governance, financial stability and institutional effectiveness. During the visit, the HLC team may speak with students, faculty and staff to better understand the Central experience. We share this information to keep you informed and to reassure you that this is a planned, routine visit that supports Central’s commitment to excellence and accountability.

First Date

Join us in the Kruidenier Center February 26th-28th at 7pm and March 1st at 2pm for the Visual & Performing Arts production of First Date. 
When blind date newbie Aaron is set up with serial-dater Casey, a casual drink at a busy New York restraunt turns into a hilarious high-stakes dinner. Can this couple turn what could be a dating disaster into something special before the check arrives? 

For tickets go to https://central.universitytickets.com

St. Mary's Catholic Church FREE shuttle bus to Sunday Mass

The Free shuttle bus to St. Mary's Catholic Church for Mass will run this Sunday 2/22/26. Pick-up will be on the west side of Central Market from 10:10 am to 10:15 am and at Independence and 3rd (4-way stop) from 10:16 am to 10:18 am. 
Pick-up times are carefully followed. Return drop-off will be at Central Market. No reservations are required. 

If you would like a weekly email with confirmation that the shuttle bus services will be provided that Sunday please email fullerj@central.edu
